exposure: Maternal inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) during pregnancy
outcome: Long-term paediatric morbidity (cardiovascular, endocrine, neurological, haematological, respiratory, gastrointestinal, urinary morbidities)
cohort: Offspring born to mothers with or without inflammatory bowel disease during pregnancy, excluding those with congenital malformations or from multiple pregnancies, delivered between 1991 and 2014.
finding: Maternal IBD during pregnancy was not associated with an increased risk for long-term paediatric morbidity (up to age 18) in the offspring.
